# Connector contracts, endpoints and credentials (handover)

<!-- Generated by `node tools/release/connector-handover.mjs --write` from the table "P6 residuals: live integrations not exercised in this environment" in `docs/delivery/environment.md`, the adapter kinds of `apps/api/src/modules/integrations/connectors.ts` and `.env.example`. Do not edit by hand: `--check` fails when this file differs from a fresh generation. -->

This list is for Mobily IT. For each integration it names the local adapter and its contract tests, the endpoint IT supplies, and the credential IT supplies **by name** (a `*_FILE` key or a SecretRef field). No credential value appears here or anywhere in the repository.

Contract tests run against local test doubles in this environment. A passing contract test proves the adapter against its local double, not against a Mobily system.

## Status against Mobily systems

Every enterprise connector below has the same status: **Not verified: no authenticated test against a Mobily endpoint has been recorded.**

> غير متحقق منه: لم يُسجَّل أي اختبار موثَّق مقابل نقطة اتصال لدى موبايلي. (ملخص عربي مؤقت)

In the product, a connector's status reads "Not verified" until a test run succeeds on its current configuration (`verification` in `connectors.ts`, derived, never stored).

## What IT supplies, as recorded in `environment.md`

Copied verbatim from the source table's "What Mobily IT supplies" and "Guide" columns, so the two documents cannot drift.

| Integration | What Mobily IT supplies | Guide |
|---|---|---|
| Corporate identity provider (OIDC) | Issuer URL (https), client ID, client secret (as `OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET_FILE`), redirect URI registration, the `email` and `name` claims, and group → role mapping input | `docs/operations/configuration.md` |
| Keycloak test realm e2e | A host with a container runtime, to run the `test-idp` profile | `docs/operations/configuration.md`; DO-B's e2e |
| Brokered SAML | The corporate SAML IdP metadata, its signing certificate and rotation, and the attribute mappings for `email` and `name` | `docs/operations/identity-saml-broker.md` (DO-B; **not yet written** at `135ff1d`) |
| IT object store (S3-compatible) | Endpoint (https), region, a private bucket, an optional key prefix, a least-privilege access key pair as secret references, and the CA if it is corporate | `docs/operations/storage.md` |
| SMTP relay | Relay host and port, security mode, optional credentials as secret references, sender address, and the CA if it is corporate | `docs/operations/notifications.md` |
| Enterprise messaging | — (a later release would add an adapter) | `docs/operations/notifications.md` |
| Corporate data source (`http_pull` connector) | The source endpoint (https), its credential as a secret reference, the field mapping, and the network route | ADR-0055; handover guide for connectors (owner: slice B) |
| AI model endpoint (optional assistant) | The endpoint, model name and credential reference of an IT-approved provider, if Mobily chooses to enable the assistant | ADR-0059; row to be confirmed by BE-T's handback |

## Connector adapter kinds

The adapter kinds a connector can use (`CONNECTOR_ADAPTER_KINDS`, imported by `connectors.ts`).

| Kind | Adapter | Contract tests | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| `test_adapter` | `apps/api/src/modules/integrations/adapters/test-adapter.ts` | `apps/api/test/integration/integrations/adapter-contract.test.ts` | The local adapter (M0335): healthy, failing or stopped on demand. Never contacts a network. |
| `webhook` | `apps/api/src/modules/integrations/webhooks.ts` | `apps/api/test/integration/integrations/webhooks.test.ts` | Inbound: the source system calls the hub's webhook endpoint with a signed request; no outbound endpoint. |
| `http_pull` | `apps/api/src/modules/integrations/adapters/http-pull.ts` | `apps/api/test/integration/integrations/adapter-contract.test.ts`<br>`apps/api/test/integration/integrations/connectors.test.ts` | Pulls rows from an IT-supplied HTTPS source (row "Corporate data source" below). |

## Secrets

- A secret is supplied as a mounted file named by `<NAME>_FILE`, or as a SecretRef (`{provider, name}`) that the file provider resolves from `SECRETS_DIR` and that `SECRET_BINDINGS_FILE` binds to one setting, one organization and the hosts it may be sent to. See `docs/operations/configuration.md`.
- Setting both `NAME` and `NAME_FILE` is refused at startup.
